lazily lie down
slowly blink a few times

lines.en: A faint hiss, and I drag you toward me.
yawn lazily
shake its head slowly

My illusion...

lines.zh: 它张开巨大的口器，发出低沉的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: It opens its giant maw, hissing lowly.

lines.zh: 它的触须快速舞动，似乎在寻找猎物。
lines.en: Its tentacles move quickly, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着绿光，盯着你。
lines.en: Its green eyes glow, staring at you.

lines.zh: 它发出一阵微弱的嗡鸣声，似乎在思考。
lines.en: It buzzes softly, as if in thought.

lines.zh: 它缓缓移动，靠近你周围的空气。
lines.en: It moves slowly, drawing the air towards you.

lines.zh: 它突然张大嘴巴，露出锋利的牙齿。
lines.en: It suddenly opens its mouth, revealing sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 它发出的光芒逐渐增强，吸引着你。
lines.en: Its light grows, drawing you in.

lines.zh: 它低吼着，声音穿透你的梦境。
lines.en: It rumbles, its voice piercing your dreams.

lines.zh: 它轻轻地咬住你，把你拖向自己。
lines.en: It gently bites you, pulling you towards itself.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛发出幽光，似乎在诱惑你。
lines.en: Its eyes emit a faint light, tempting you.

lines.zh: 它突然向你扑来，你几乎无法躲避。
lines.en: It suddenly lunges at you, nearly impossible to dodge.

lines.zh: 它的身体撞上你，让你感到一阵剧痛。
lines.en: Its body crashes into you, causing intense pain.

lines.zh: 它的触须缠绕在你身上，让你动弹不得。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around you, immobilizing you.

lines.zh: 它用巨大的爪子拍打你，让你感到惊恐。
lines.en: It slaps you with its giant claws, terrifying you.

lines.zh: 它迅速靠近，让你几乎没有反应时间。
lines.en: It quickly approaches, leaving you with little reaction time.

lines.zh: 它的身体重重地撞向你，将你撞飞。
lines.en: Its body hits you hard, sending you flying.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀拍打，将你击倒在地。
lines.en: Its wings beat, knocking you down.

lines.zh: 它撞向你，你被甩出几米远。
lines.en: It collides with you, flinging you several meters.

lines.zh: 它的力量巨大，几乎压垮你。
lines.en: Its strength is immense, nearly crushing you.

lines.zh: 它用巨大的尾巴抽打你，让你难以站立。
lines.en: It whips you with its huge tail, leaving you staggering.

lines.zh: 它发出悦耳的声音，吸引着它的伴侣。
lines.en: It emits a pleasant sound, attracting its mate.

lines.zh: 它的触须轻轻触碰，表达爱意。
lines.en: Its tentacles gently touch, expressing affection.

lines.zh: 它发出低沉的叫声，呼唤它的伴侣。
lines.en: It makes a low, calling sound for its mate.

lines.zh: 它的身体靠近，似乎在寻求拥抱。
lines.en: Its body moves close, seeking a hug.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛发出温暖的光，表达情感。
lines.en: Its eyes emit warm light, expressing emotion.

lines.zh: 它发出轻柔的声音，表达亲密。
lines.en: It makes soft sounds, expressing intimacy.

lines.zh: 它的触须轻轻触碰，像是在跳舞。
lines.en: Its tentacles gently touch, like dancing.

lines.zh: 它用身体围住，保护它的伴侣。
lines.en: It surrounds with its body, protecting its mate.

lines.zh: 它发出欢快的声音，庆祝彼此的存在。
lines.en: It emits a joyful sound, celebrating their presence.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着爱意，紧紧拥抱伴侣。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with love, hugging its partner tightly.

lines.zh: 肮脏的珍珠在手心闪烁。
lines.en: Dirty pearl glimmers in your hand.
The pearl writhes in your hand.
The pearl emits a foul stench.
The pearl is marred with blood.
You feel the pearl trembling.
The pearl seems to breathe.
Nightmares pulse within the pearl.

lines.zh: 珍珠散发出冰冷的气息。
lines.en: The pearl exudes a cold aura.

lines.zh: 珍珠中似乎有东西在移动。
lines.en: Something moves within the pearl.

lines.zh: 你感到一股邪恶力量涌入。
lines.en: Evil forces surge into you.
You are pulled toward me.
You feel my call.

lines.zh: 你被一股无形力量牵引。
lines.en: You are drawn by an invisible force.
You are sucked into my tentacles.

lines.zh: 你被我强大的意志控制。
lines.en: You are controlled by my will.
You are drawn by my voice.
You are drawn by dark power.
You sense my presence.

lines.zh: 你被一股神秘力量牵引。
lines.en: You are drawn by mysterious forces.
You are ensnared by dark tendrils.
Your heels leave the ground.
Gravity changes direction, toward it.

lines.zh: 它什么也没做，你就滑过去
lines.en: It does nothing, and you slide over.
The ten-block circle; you are inside it.

lines.zh: 它把整片空气往怀里收
lines.en: It pulls the whole patch of air inward.

lines.zh: 它攻击力为零，只想抱住你
lines.en: Its attack is zero; it only wants to hold you.
You are my target.
Your location is locked.
You are my prey.
I will drag you to the abyss.

lines.zh: 十格之内，你正被拉向我。
lines.en: Within ten blocks, you're being pulled to me.
You will feel my power.
You will be devoured.
I will rip you apart.

lines.zh: 别急，我的拉扯会把你带来。
lines.en: No hurry; my pull will bring you here.
I will plunge you into dreams.
It gathers slowly, like a rising tide.
One step forward, two dragged back.
It is in no hurry, but the pull never stops.
The ground tilts two degrees toward it.
Your shadow reaches its feet first.

lines.zh: 它张开双臂，等你自己来
lines.en: It spreads its arms and waits for you.

lines.zh: 肌肉一层层绷紧，往它那边
lines.en: Muscles tighten layer by layer, its way.
Every breath, the gap shrinks a block.

lines.zh: 它把你的名字含在嘴里
lines.en: It holds your name in its mouth.
You retreat; it just tightens the circle.
It stretches tentacles to pull you close!
Dreamtorn! You're pulled closer!
Tentacles grab, come closer!
Can you smell its presence?
Its tentacles prepare to embrace!
Dark force pulls you closer!
What does it mean to approach?
Tentacles entwine like vines!
You can't escape its tentacles!
Tentacles pull you into dreams!
It has no teeth, only suction.
Get close and you are wrapped in.

lines.zh: 它的身体像热蜡一样合上
lines.en: Its body closes like warm wax.

lines.zh: 你被按在它胸口，动不了
lines.en: Pressed to its chest, you cannot move.
It does not hurt you; it just will not let go.
Your struggling is slowly absorbed.

lines.zh: 梦里也有人这样抱过你吗
lines.en: Has anyone held you like this in a dream?

lines.zh: 它的手一圈一圈缠上来
lines.en: Its arms coil around you, ring by ring.

lines.zh: 你听见自己的心跳被拉长
lines.en: You hear your heartbeat stretched thin.
Gently, it pulls you down.
It appears in the dreams!

lines.zh: 夜幕降临，它现身于梦魇！
lines.en: It emerges in the nightmare at night!
It surfaces in the dreamy abyss!
Its shadow in the first layer of the nightmare!

lines.zh: 它在梦境的黑暗中等待！
lines.en: It waits in the dark of dreams!
It follows in the night's shadow!
It appears in the corners of dreams!
It emerges in the nightmare's shadow!
Its outline appears in the nightmare!
It waits in the night's darkness!

lines.zh: 梦魇第一层，地面鼓起来
lines.en: Nightmare's first floor; the ground swells.

lines.zh: 六十点血，不还手的存在
lines.en: Sixty health, and it never strikes back.
Fire burns me...
Falling pain...
Water surrounds me...
Explosion hits me...
Arrow pierces me...
Magic power...
Starvation torture...
Lightning strikes me...
Void devours me...
